query: Will the interest rates on savings in the Special, MediSave and Retirement Account be maintained at a floor rate?
reference_answer: To help CPF members grow their savings, the Government has decided to further extend the 4% floor rate for interest earned on all Special, MediSave and Retirement Account (SMRA) savings for another year until 31 December 2025.SMRA savings will earn a minimum 4% interest rate per annum until 31 December 2025.Please refer to our FAQ onhow CPF interest rates are determinedfor more information.
answer: Without specific information, it's uncertain if interest rates will remain at a floor rate for Special, MediSave, and Retirement Accounts. [Document 1]
